meta.title: Vietnam's BEST STREET FOOD in Hoi An 🇻🇳
meta.description:
Exploring the best Hoi An street food! 🇻🇳 From $1 hidden gems to the world-famous Hoi An Chicken Rice, we spent 3 days eating our way through the Old Town. This is the ultimate Vietnam food tour guide for 2026, featuring local prices and the must-try dishes you can't find anywhere else.

📍 Featured in this video:
Pho Xua: Authentic Beef Pho ($3 / 70,000 VND)

Local Cao Lầu: The legendary thick noodles of Hoi An ($2.50 / 60,000 VND)

Chè Hai Chị Em: Traditional Vietnamese Sweet Soup ($1.50 / 40,000 VND)

Cô Phương: Vietnamese Sandwich Bahn Mi ($0.90 / 25,000 VND)

Cơm Gà Giếng Đình: Famous Hoi An Chicken Rice ($1.60 / 40,000 VND)

BBQ Nướng Khói: Interactive Tabletop Charcoal Grill

Hoi An Night Market: $1 Banana Pancakes & Snail Wraps
